dataset_type: Synthetic, fictional Indian retail marketing business dataset
known_raw_issues: 2 marketing channel names with inconsistent casing/whitespace
notes: All business entities and performance outcomes are synthetic and must be presented as simulated portfolio data, not real company results.
Daily performance is sampled reporting days during campaign dates; absence of a date means no row was recorded, not necessarily zero activity.
ROAS can be calculated as attributed order value divided by ad spend, but attribution is simplified to campaign-linked synthetic data.
Cost per lead and cost per conversion can be calculated. True CAC is not established because customer identity and complete acquisition costs are not available.
Marketing ROI is not fully supported because product costs, gross margin and non-advertising costs are not included.
Raw folder is intentionally imperfect for preprocessing practice. Cleaned folder is normalized and validated.
